products.label: The Melange
products.description: A media-intelligence dashboard that reads online news from Bangladesh automatically and scores every story for tone, stance and hostility. All of it appears on a single screen. Melange collects stories from many outlets, scores them automatically, and shows them live — so you see what is breaking, what is spreading across outlets, and where the tone is shifting, without opening a dozen tabs.
features: Live feed of national and Bangla outlets with timestamps
Pulse charts (24h / 48h / 7d) showing coverage spikes
Tone, stance and hostility scoring on every article
Claims flagging, watchlists, entities and alerts
Bilingual interface: English and বাংলা

products.label: Space Prep
products.summary: Learn with spaced repetition. Master your test preparation.
products.description: A self-paced learning and test-prep platform that uses spaced repetition — flashcards that come back just before you would forget them — together with quizzes and structured modules. Stop re-reading. Start remembering. Space Prep schedules reviews for you, gives instant feedback, and shows your mastery so you always know what to study next.
features: Spaced-repetition flashcards with a daily ‘cards due’ queue
90+ built-in quizzes with instant feedback
9 beginner-friendly modules: Power Query, DAX, visualisations and more
Dashboard and leaderboard to track progress and compete with peers
Batch codes to join a class or cohort

products.label: Dialo
products.summary: A lead-intelligence engine that makes AI call for your product.
products.description: A sales-automation tool that finds and qualifies leads, then uses an AI voice agent to call them on your behalf. Cold calling is slow, repetitive and expensive. Most leads go cold because nobody calls them in time. Dialo finds the right leads and has AI make the first call — your team only steps in when someone is genuinely interested.
features: Lead intelligence to find and prioritise prospects
AI-powered outbound calling for your product or service
Qualification of interest before a human gets involved
Call outcomes and lead status in one place

products.label: Khela Connect
products.summary: Connect with your peers over turf games.
products.description: A social platform for sports players that connects them with others to organise, join and play turf games such as football and cricket. Turf games fall apart when you cannot find enough players. Group chats get messy, and last-minute dropouts spoil the plan. Khela Connect lets you find nearby players, set up matches and fill your squad, so every game actually happens.
features: Discover players and teams nearby
Create or join turf games in your city
Connect with peers at your sport and skill level
Build a local sports community

products.label: Prompt Grabber
products.summary: Collect your prompts. Pool your AI skills and super prompts.
products.description: A tool that connects to your AI chats, collects the prompts you use, and keeps them in a cloud pool you can reuse. Your best prompts are scattered across chat histories, notes and screenshots. You rewrite them every time. Prompt Grabber captures prompts as you work and stores them in one searchable cloud library — so your best prompts are always one click away on any device.
features: Prompt capture from your AI workflow
A cloud pool that syncs across devices
Library for reusable AI skills and super prompts
Quick reuse instead of rewriting
Backend powered by Supabase

products.label: DevLens
products.summary: A Chrome extension that helps you prompt your frontend faster.
products.description: A developer extension for localhost sites. It lets you point at any element in your running app and hand an AI assistant exactly the context it needs, so vibe coding is faster and more accurate. Telling an AI “change that button on the left” does not work. DevLens identifies the source of the element you are looking at, maps its dependencies, and copies a compact, precise context block for your AI prompt.
features: Hover source inspector: hover any element to see its component source, Ctrl+Click copies context
Dependency graphs and change-impact analysis
Position mode: Ctrl+Shift overlay for grid, flex and coordinate context
Automatic style detection — picks up your stack without setup
Clean toolbar: red when inactive, green when active

products.label: BARTA
products.summary: Stay updated with the news, and actually remember it.
products.description: A news-reader app that keeps you current and helps you retain what you read. ‘Barta’ (বার্তা) means ‘news’ in Bangla. It combines AI summaries, spaced repetition, keyword tagging and mind maps, so a story becomes knowledge you keep rather than a headline you forget.
features: AI summaries: short, clear takes so you read more in less time
Spaced repetition (SM-2): key facts return at the right intervals
Keyword tagging: organise and find stories by topic, person or place
Mind maps: see how stories and topics connect
Clean mobile-first feed, modern and easy to scan daily

services.label: Service 01
services.title: AI Business & Algorithmic Audit
services.summary: 14-day computational audit isolating precision bottlenecks and drafting an autonomous deployment blueprint.
services.detail: Enterprise ROI and computational architecture are inseparable. We deconstruct workflow telemetry, isolate your single costliest operational bottleneck, and benchmark dedicated compute vs. token ROI before writing production code.
services.text: Enterprise ROI and computational architecture are inseparable. Instead of locking into multi-million-dollar annual software subscriptions for generic feature bloat, our systems researchers embed across your operations to conduct an exhaustive 14-day computational audit. We deconstruct workflow telemetry, isolate the single costliest bottleneck, and engineer a dedicated autonomous blueprint targeted exclusively at eliminating it.
features: Workflow latency profiling
Bottleneck decomposition & dependency trees
Token economics vs. dedicated compute ROI

services.label: Service 02
services.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms
services.summary: Decentralized self-governing agent meshes executing concurrent operations with sub-second finality.
services.detail: Specialized multi-agent swarms operating on continuous causal verification loops and symbolic proofs to eliminate probabilistic hallucination and drift.
services.text: We engineer self-governing multi-agent meshes that independently negotiate, decompose complex multi-stage objectives, and execute concurrent operations with sub-second finality. Bypassing the probabilistic drift and hallucinations of generic LLMs, our agent swarms operate on continuous causal verification loops backed by formal symbolic proofs.
features: Decentralized peer-to-peer consensus
Dynamic autonomous task decomposition
Microsecond inter-agent event bus

services.label: Service 03
services.title: Sovereign AI Platforms
services.summary: Turnkey air-gapped cognitive intelligence layers operating strictly inside private hardware perimeters.
services.detail: Mission-critical inference clusters deployed on bare-metal hardware with zero external API leakage, bespoke weight fine-tuning, and audit-grade compliance.
services.text: Mission-critical institutions cannot risk proprietary trade secrets, customer records, or classified telemetry on public multi-tenant cloud APIs. We deploy turnkey, air-gapped cognitive intelligence layers operating strictly inside your private hardware perimeters — delivering frontier model capabilities with zero external data egress and audit-grade compliance.
features: Air-gapped bare-metal cluster topology
Zero-egress network architecture
Bespoke domain weight adaptation

services.label: Service 04
services.title: Synthetic Perception & Vision
services.summary: High-dimensional spatial latent models and real-time edge visual inspection pipelines.
services.detail: Bridging computational neuroscience with spatial intelligence to automate physical robotics, defense telemetry, and high-frequency visual inspection.
services.text: Bridging computational neuroscience with spatial latent representations. We build real-time visual inspection pipelines, physical robotics sensor fusion, and generative synthetic dataset generators engineered for mission-critical automation across industrial robotics, sovereign defense systems, and high-frequency digital workflows.
features: Spatial latent world modeling
Sub-5ms edge visual inference
Generative synthetic training datasets

services.label: Service 05
services.title: Accelerated Systems Engineering
services.summary: Custom CUDA & Triton kernel compilation for 4-bit and 2-bit quantized neural runtimes.
services.detail: Compiling neural intelligence directly onto silicon. Eliminates runtime frameworks, slashes inference power consumption by 80%, and yields sub-millisecond throughput.
services.text: Deploying neural runtimes directly on bare silicon. We fuse custom CUDA and Triton kernels with stripped-down 4-bit and 2-bit quantized neural weights — eliminating bloated runtime frameworks, reducing inference compute costs by up to 80%, and providing guaranteed deterministic throughput under peak institutional workloads.
features: 4-bit & 2-bit quantized weight compilation
Custom CUDA, Triton & Metal kernel fusion
Bare-metal GPU VRAM optimization
